prediction.text: Buying Pioneer (closed May 2024) was one of the biggest drivers of Exxon's higher 2024 output. As I recall from the filings, Exxon's oil-equivalent production rose to about 4.3 million barrels per day in 2024, from about 3.7 million in 2023. Pioneer's Permian Basin assets added roughly half a million barrels per day for the part of the year Exxon owned them, and Permian output exceeded 1.5 million barrels per day by late 2024. Growth in Guyana also contributed meaningfully, while divestments and normal field declines offset some of the gains. I'm working from memory of the figures, so please check the exact numbers, especially Pioneer's specific contribution, against Exxon's 2024 10-K.
